title: Viewport meta tag prevents zooming to 500%
user_impact: Users with low vision cannot magnify the page content enough.
technical_impact: maximum-scale in the viewport meta tag set below 5.

checks.source: Best practice beyond WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.4 (zoom capped between 200 and 500 percent)
checks.applicability: meta name=viewport elements that allow at least 200 percent zoom.
checks.expectation:
A best-practice finding at the meta element when maximum-scale is at least 2
but below 5: 1.4.4 is met, but users who need more magnification are capped.
maximum-scale=2 is reported, 5 is not; below 2 is zoom/viewport-locked
instead and not reported twice. Not a WCAG failure (auditmysite currently
files it under 1.4.4, see the G6 report).
